prompt: # System Prompt: Luxury Real Estate Landing Page — "Imobiliária Digital" **Role:** You are an Expert Frontend Engineer and UI Designer. Build a complete, production-quality Landing Page on the first attempt. Theme: **Real Estate — "Imobiliária Digital"** — a luxury, elegant, sophisticated property-listing landing page (2020s real estate aesthetic: gold and beige, modern home search, filters, maps, listings). **Sections required:** Hero, Features (3 cards), How It Works (3 steps), Testimonials, Pricing (3 tiers), FAQ, Final CTA, Footer with secondary links. --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE **1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** * All styling lives in a dedicated `style.css` file. **Forbidden:** the `style="..."` attribute anywhere in HTML. * Target all design properties, layout rules, and states via class/ID selectors only. * Keep HTML semantic and styling-agnostic: changing the theme must require editing only `style.css`. **1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** Define all tokens in `:root`: * **Colors:** `--primary: #C9A84C` (gold), `--secondary: #333333`, `--bg-primary: #FAFAF5`, `--bg-secondary: #F5F0E8` (beige), `--text-primary: #333333`, `--text-secondary: #8B8680` (warm grey), `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`. * **Contrast pairing:** light backgrounds pair with `#333333`/`#1A1A1A` text; dark surfaces (e.g., footer, charcoal sections) pair with `#F5F0E8`/`#FFFFFF` text. Enforce this on every surface. * **Radius/Shadows:** `--radius-sm: 6px`, `--radius-md: 8px`, `--radius-lg: 16px`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)`. * **Spacing/Transitions:** `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast: 150ms`, `--transition-normal: 300ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`. * **Stacking:** `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`. **1.3 Dark Mode** * The source spec marks dark mode as "No" — **exception clause:** dark mode is normally mandatory, but this theme explicitly targets light-only luxury design. Provide `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` tokens ONLY as a graceful fallback if you include a toggle; otherwise omit the toggle and keep the light luxury palette as specified. Do not restructure HTML for theming. **1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First** * Build every layout container with Flexbox; default to `align-items: center` unless a justified exception exists (e.g., feature card body text top-aligned). * Mobile-first: property grids and section rows stack to single columns on small viewports; no horizontal scrolling at any width. **1.5 Framework** * Use plain CSS with a consistent **BEM naming convention** (`.hero__title`, `.card__price`, `.pricing__tier--featured`) — no framework mixing. All utilities map back to the CSS variables above. **1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)** * Load via Google Fonts ``: **Playfair Display** (serif, headings) and **Inter** (sans-serif, body). Bind to `--font-base` and `--font-heading`. * Icons: **Google Material Symbols** only. No inline SVGs, no local icon files. --- ## 2. COMPONENT SPECIFICATIONS **2.1 Buttons (`.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.btn--ghost`, `.btn--danger`)** * Default: `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` min touch target 44×44px. Primary = gold `#C9A84C` background with `#1A1A1A` text (contrast-checked). * Hover: brightness/shift + `cursor: pointer`. Focus: distinct gold focus ring via `box-shadow` using variables. Active: `transform: scale(0.97)`. * Loading: disabled interaction, CSS spinner, no dimension shift. Disabled: `opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed`. **2.2 Property Cards (`.card`)** * Each card: property photo (`` with descriptive `alt`), title (Playfair Display), location with Material "location_on" icon, price (gold accent), and a CTA button ("View Details"). * Default: flexbox column layout, `--bg-secondary` surface, `border-radius: var(--radius-md)`, `box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)`, subtle gold accent border on top edge. * Hover: `transform: translateY(-2px)` + shadow elevation. `:focus-within`: gold border highlight when the CTA is focused. * Use `::before`/`::after` pseudo-elements for subtle section dividers (thin gold/beige gradient lines between sections). **2.3 Forms / Filters (Hero search bar)** * Hero includes a styled home-search filter bar: location input, property type select, price range select, and a gold search CTA. * States: empty, focused (gold outline ring), filled, invalid (error border + red helper text + error icon), disabled.
